So far, six feature flows are settled:

- Effortless saving with readable details, editing, and duplicate prevention
- Personal labels with suggestions, removal, and filtering
- Plain and precise search
- A dedicated Read Later queue
- Reversible archiving and restoration
- Carefully confirmed permanent deletion

The empty, invalid, failure, long-content, cancellation, and time-related cases are also settled.

May I start implementing this scope as the finished web app?
